# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Applied the two pending shrimp-model amendments. Calcium and magnesium minimum handling now uses defensive zero guards alongside GH so zero-valued thresholds no longer propagate NaN/Inf through `update_molt_stress` or `molt_mineral_modifier`, and snapshot-side `repro_dominant_suppression` now reuses a shared runtime reproduction-factor helper so it stays aligned with `update_reproductive_readiness`, including `molt_stress` plus separate `tan` and `nitrite` labels. I also added regression coverage for zero Ca/Mg thresholds and for the runtime-aligned snapshot suppression labels.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspect the pending amendment sites in `shrimp.rs`, `snapshot.rs`, and the existing molt/reproduction tests to confirm the divide-by-zero paths and the snapshot/runtime suppression-model mismatch.
2. [Completed] Implement defensive Ca/Mg minimum guards in molt stress and mineral modifier calculations, then replace the snapshot-local dominant suppression logic with a shared runtime reproduction-factor helper that includes molt stress and separate TAN/nitrite factors.
3. [Completed] Add regression tests for zero Ca/Mg minimum thresholds and runtime-aligned snapshot suppression labels, format the crate, and run targeted validation on the touched paths.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test molt_mineral_budget -- --nocapture` passed (16/16), including `test_zero_ca_and_mg_min_parameters_use_defensive_guards`.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors test_snapshot_reports_dominant_suppression -- --nocapture` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors test_snapshot_uses_runtime_suppression_labels -- --nocapture` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --lib snapshot_uses_one_carbonate_solution_for_ph_and_co2 -- --nocapture` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors -- --nocapture` still fails in the pre-existing `test_mature_stable_tank_breeds_well`; the new snapshot-label test added in this pass passed under filtered execution.

## Outstanding Risks

- Config validation still enforces positive `shrimp_params.ca_min_mg_per_l` and `shrimp_params.mg_min_mg_per_l`; the runtime is now defensive if zero leaks in, but save/load validation still rejects zero-valued configs.
- Validation was targeted rather than full-package: `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors -- --nocapture` still hits the existing unrelated failure `test_mature_stable_tank_breeds_well`, so this pass relied on the filtered reproduction tests plus the touched mineral/snapshot coverage.
